what: Experiment 1 FULL reproduction (re-solves all three certified seeds) from a clean clone, a fresh venv built from requirements-lock.txt and an emptied data/cache/ (docs/REPRODUCE.md, 'Recorded reproduction')
launcher: env -i PATH=<venv>/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=/root PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, run under `unshare -m` with the development container's upload folder masked by an empty tmpfs, so the frozen code could read only the registered files under data/raw/
cache: data/cache/ empty at the first launch (cold): the path-set build is part of this run

hardware.host_note: the same Linux x86_64 development container that produced the late-stage artifacts; not a different machine

environment.blas: scipy-openblas 0.3.31.188.0 (OpenBLAS 0.3.31.188.0 USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Haswell MAX_THREADS=64)

sessions.note: The development container restarted twice during the run. Each restart killed the process; the launcher was re-run and the command resumed from its checkpoint file (--state), which records each completed optimizer restart per seed. Resuming is exact: the resumed seed-20260825 and seed-20260827 solves returned the recorded plan digests.

wall_time.note: includes the cold path-set build and the time lost to the two restarts (work after a seed's last checkpoint was redone). Uninterrupted solve times recorded by the original study: 2860.6 s, 3008.3 s, 2829.3 s per seed; seed 20260826, which ran uninterrupted here, took 2994.2 s.

gated_drift.checks: n_paths (243257); per seed: unserved_change_pct and gc_change_pct of the recorded plan re-evaluated, and resolved_unserved_change_pct, resolved_gc_change_pct and resolved_plan_route_periods_differing of the newly solved plan

informational_not_gated.note: the reference is the frontier instance (outputs/exp1_baseline_modelB.json); the seed-check instance's own baseline is not recorded in any artifact. Same values as the smoke receipt exp1_smoke_2026-10-05.json.

status_meaning: every gated check has zero drift and all three re-solved plans are identical (plan digest and route-period-by-route-period) to the recorded certified plans
limits: same platform as the original study: this is a reproduction on the original host class, not a cross-platform replication
single process per seed, threads pinned to 1; multi-threaded BLAS was not tested
